note: Sanitized evidence from a physical ESP32-C6 (native USB Serial/JTAG, hwlab espusbjtag, no OpenOCD/Python/ESP-IDF/CGO). Only metadata and hashes: no firmware bytes, no MAC (USB serial replaced by AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). The full flash backup stays a local artifact and is never committed.

boot.proof: SRAM counter at the image's hwlab_counter symbol increments: the ROM loaded and started the programmed image

unplug_replug.classification_after_unplug: DEVICE_GONE on every call (memory read, identify, scan, chip_info); no hang, no stale success
unplug_replug.rediscovered_by: USB serial number (bus/device number changed and is not identity)
unplug_replug.after_replug: identity (serial, IDCODE, ROM chip-detect word) equal, JTAG scan ok, ROM read ok
unplug_replug.errno_seen: ENODEV in both rounds; the EPROTO->DEVICE_GONE mapping is code-only and was not exercised on hardware

incident: An earlier acceptance run's error-path case wrote zeros over bootloader, partition table and otadata because the multi-region check ignored the bootloader slot and the image-magic check was missing. The flash was restored byte-for-byte from the fresh backup; program now refuses multi-region writes and raw data without raw=true.
